sources.wakeups: proc_pid_rusage ri_interrupt_wkups (all wakeups from idle; includes ri_pkg_idle_wkups, which is 0 on Apple silicon and reported apart as pkg_idle_wakeups)
sources.footprint: proc_pid_rusage ri_phys_footprint (Activity Monitor Memory; footprint(1) total)
sources.disk_written: proc_pid_rusage ri_logical_writes (bytes written to files by the process, before the buffer cache; the most precise unprivileged per-process write counter on macOS)
sources.disk_io_written: proc_pid_rusage ri_diskio_byteswritten (I/O the process issued to storage)
sources.socket_bytes: bytes the harness's own clients receive (attach streams, acpmux send); macOS has no unprivileged per-process Unix-socket byte counter
